label: Ikony · Elvis
desc: Rozkročený postoj, kolena dovnitř a ven, kroužení boků, třesoucí se noha, švih ruky nad hlavu.
desc_en: A wide stance, knees swinging in and out, circling hips, a shaking leg, an arm swung overhead.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer stands with feet wide apart and knees bent, knees swinging inward and outward in rhythm, hands loosely holding an imaginary microphone stand, and ends with knees together
the hips circle and snap from side to side while the arms swing loosely away from the body, one shoulder dipping with each snap, and end mid-swing with hips pushed to one side
one leg shakes rapidly on the ball of the foot, the knee vibrating fast while the rest of the body stays still, then the shaking stops
one arm swings up high over the head and sweeps down with a deep lunge to one side, the other arm pointing out, and ends low in the lunge
the dancer rises from the lunge into a still pose with the head tilted, one corner of the mouth lifted in a half smile, and holds it
